cohort: 294 antenatal women in their third trimester with singleton pregnancies, admitted to an obstetric ward for other indications, were recruited.
finding: The study found an association between maternal thyroid disorders and maternal anemia, preeclampsia, increased cesarean delivery, presence of low birth weight babies, low Apgar score, and increased NICU admissions.
mod_finding: The study found an association between maternal thyroid disorders and an increased rate of cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Recruitment and thyroid profile assessment were conducted in the third trimester, and maternal/fetal outcomes were assessed around birth.
